claim_ceiling: Running this corpus characterizes candidate extraction behaviour on this corpus under one identified implementation commit, provider, model, and run condition. It establishes no semantic correctness, institutional admission, authority, enforceability, readiness, or independent validation.
purpose: Frozen synthetic corpus for pre-admission characterization of SOURCE-GROUNDED OIC candidate extraction. Every specimen is invented for testing and describes no real institution, policy, or obligation. Carries every OIC-CANDIDATE-SEMANTICS-001 specimen unchanged so before/after behaviour is measurable, adds six source-grounding pre-registrations per specimen, and adds eight diagnostic specimens for the evidenced failure classes.
span_list_semantics: Every *_spans list is DISJUNCTIVE and describes ONE required element: the element is preserved when at least one listed rendering appears. A list does not enumerate several independent required elements.
